d:
A massive 11,000 MW hydropower project on the Siang River in Arunachal Pradesh has triggered widespread protests among the indigenous Adi community. While the government argues that the project is crucial for India's national security, local communities fear losing their ancestral lands, homes, livelihoods and cultural identity.
At the forefront of this movement is Katon Moyong, popularly known as the 'Abor Man' — an environmental engineer and activist from the Adi community.
